notes: מֵעָלָי was aligned with מִן taking the single written 'from' and עַל marked unrepresented under rule 2. Rule 30 governs instead: a contiguous compound preposition rendered by one English word is one unit, and rule 30 explicitly rejects the shape of one rendered morpheme beside another marked unrepresented for such an expression. The same chapter fuses מִבְּלִי -> 'without' in JER.2.15, and the corpus reads the parallel מֵאֵת as one unit in 26 places. Only the two preposition units are merged; every other unit is returned unchanged.
